heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 626 of Pub. L. 93–383 was classified to section 5425 of this title, prior to repeal by Pub. L. 106–569.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective upon the expiration of 180 days following Aug. 22, 1974, see section 627 of Pub. L. 93–383, set out as a note under section 5401 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 93–383, title VI, § 626, formerly § 627, Aug. 22, 1974, 88 Stat. 714; renumbered § 626, Pub. L. 106–569, title VI, § 611(2), Dec. 27, 2000, 114 Stat. 3012.)
